lines.en: I drift in the water, not of my own will.

lines.zh: 八条腕往同一个方向拉。
lines.en: Eight arms pull the same way.
My body is heavier than my kind's.

lines.zh: 我顺着洞窟里的暗流走。
lines.en: I follow the dark current in the cave.

lines.zh: 我一路往有光的地方挪。
lines.en: I keep moving toward the light.
The water cools where I pass.

lines.zh: 我的腕缠在石头上，又松开。
lines.en: My arms coil on stone, then let go.

lines.zh: 我漂过一片发白的水草。
lines.en: I drift past a patch of pale weed.
I pause, then move on.

lines.zh: 我听命于一个不在这儿的。
lines.en: Something absent is giving me orders.
My shadow sways on the pool floor.
I squeeze out through a rock gap.
My own movements do not feel like mine.
I am pushed toward deeper water.

lines.zh: 我慢慢沉下去，又浮上来。
lines.en: I sink slowly, then rise.
There are other eyes at the bottom.
I hang with my arms drooping.

lines.zh: 我身体里像有别的心跳。
lines.en: There is another heartbeat in me.
The water is still and I hear myself.
One of my arms moves on its own.
I listen to water dripping overhead.

lines.zh: 紫色的光在我皮下一闪。
lines.en: A purple glow flickers under my skin.
Light spots move on the surface.

lines.zh: 这一池水原本是我的家。
lines.en: This pool used to be my home.
Half-lidded, I watch the water light.
I count the water marks on the cave wall.

lines.zh: 有个声音在很远的地方。
lines.en: A voice is somewhere far off.
My body is very cold.
All eight arms draw to one side.
You stand on the bank.

lines.zh: 我看见你了，可我说不出。
lines.en: I see you, and I cannot say it.
Water drips off me.

lines.zh: 我也许曾经是你这个样子。
lines.en: Perhaps I was once like you.
Do you see the dark in this cave?

lines.zh: 你听见有人在你身后吗。
lines.en: Do you hear something behind you?
My eyes do not obey me.
Do not touch the pool water.
You are deciding whether to leave.

lines.zh: 我的腕尖指了一下洞深处。
lines.en: Mine arm tips point deeper into the cave.
One of my arms flinches back.
The water is churned.
The pain sinks me lower.
My body is trembling.
My skin has split somewhere.
I release a cloud of ink.
I pull into a hole in the floor.
A voice is laughing.
I can still swim.
I want that little light.
I drift a little toward the bank.

lines.zh: 水纹把你的影子扯歪了。
lines.en: The ripples pull your shadow crooked.
Lower your hand; I can reach.
I extend one arm.
This is what I was looking for.
It is wrapped twice in my arms.
Is there anything else?
I press it to the bottom.
I ought to take it back.
You touched me and water splashed.
My arms bind your wrist.
I did not let go.

lines.zh: 你挣开了，皮肤上留着凉。
lines.en: You pulled free with a chill on your skin.
The water is churned opaque.
I slide behind the reef rock.
Something is pushing me.
You are standing on the silty bottom.
The pool settles again.
I loosen my arms slowly.
I am not myself anymore.
That should not be answered by me.
I am the only one in this pool.
Ask that voice.
My body does not obey me well.
I sink to the bottom.
My arms retract.
That subject hurts my head.
I sway away.
Do not ask me again.
I curl an arm around it.
It slipped between my arms.

lines.zh: 我用整个身子把它盖住。
lines.en: I cover it with my whole body.
This thing is cold in a different way.
I hold it between two arms.

lines.zh: 它在我手里发了一点光。
lines.en: It glowed a little in my grip.
I put it in my mouth.
It will not bite; I spit it out.
I set it on the pool floor.
The pattern on the water changed.
The pool water rocked that way.
A voice is telling me to go.
All my arms reach one way.
I begin swimming toward the bank.
You have backed to the water's edge.
The water at the bottom pushes me.
I do not much want to move, and I move.
My colour has darkened.

lines.zh: 你在岸边走，我在水里跟。
lines.en: You walk the bank; I follow in the water.
I keep to the pool floor.
You have stopped.
I extend one arm to test.
My movements are stiff.
Weeds block me; I go around.
Your shadow is close to the water.
I am a little closer.
A thin line shows on the surface.
My arm lashes your leg.

lines.zh: 我缠住你的脚往深处拽。
lines.en: I coil your foot and pull deep.

lines.zh: 这一下不重，但我缠得紧。
lines.en: It was light, but my grip is tight.
You cut at the water; I slip aside.
My arms carry many small hooks.
I release one arm and coil another.
You are pulled into knee-deep water.
My ink has spread.
You cough water and cannot see me.

lines.zh: 我从池底的泥里浮起来。
lines.en: I rise from the silt at the pool floor.
The dark here is heavier than elsewhere.
I used to live in this pool.
Something has entered me.

lines.zh: 我的腕一伸一缩，不受控。
lines.en: My arms reach and withdraw uncontrolled.
The light on the water is cold.
I hear water dripping from the roof.
I begin moving toward the bank.

lines.zh: 这具身体还记得怎么游。
lines.en: This body still remembers how to swim.
I open my arms slowly.

lines.zh: 水都烫了，我的腕缩成一团。
lines.en: The water heats and my arms curl tight.

lines.zh: 我从高处跌进浅水，砸得发懵。
lines.en: I fall into shallow water and lie dazed.
The water fills me and I am stifled.

lines.zh: 爆风把我从池里掀起来。
lines.en: The blast lifts me out of the pool.

lines.zh: 一支箭穿过水，扎进我身体。
lines.en: An arrow parts the water and strikes me.

lines.zh: 那股力量顺着水钻进我。
lines.en: That force enters me through the water.

lines.zh: 池里没吃的，我越来越虚。
lines.en: Nothing to eat in the pool; I weaken.

lines.zh: 雷打进水里，我整具都麻了。
lines.en: Lightning strikes the water and I go numb.

lines.zh: 水没了，我的腕在空中乱抓。
lines.en: The water is gone; my arms grasp at air.
